summary: Keep one active Teranet statutory-registry platform and reject the queued duplicate OMERS owner addition. Borealis and OMERS Infrastructure are one manager lineage; OMERS currently owns 100% through Teranet Holdings LP. Correct the current period to the September 4, 2008 announcement and November 11, 2008 control date, add the Province, Teramira and public Income Fund ownership history, and separate equity ownership from Ontario/Manitoba statutory rights, debt and subsidiaries.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: The exact 1991 formation day and full Teramira consortium cap table are not publicly disclosed.
The exact residual-unit acquisition date after control passed on November 11, 2008 is not publicly disclosed; current 100% OMERS ownership is resolved.
The OMERS internal account name beyond balance-sheet ownership is not publicly disclosed; no co-investor was found.
recommendedActions: Retain one canonical Teranet Inc. company covering the manager-level registry platform and controlled registry subsidiaries.

Retain one active OMERS Infrastructure ownership period, set the 100% stake, September 4, 2008 announcement and November 11, 2008 control date, and preserve Borealis as the predecessor manager label rather than a second owner.

Add the Province of Ontario, Teramira and Teranet Income Fund/public ownership periods as historical context without turning statutory licences, governments, systems or holdcos into current equity owners.
Preserve the Ontario and Manitoba statutory-right terms as operating metadata, not equity transactions; record no signed pending ownership transaction.
